method: Built-in imagegen; original badge used as a style reference. Generated neutral silver masters are retained unchanged.
bottom_plate:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated modular achievement-badge bottom plate, transparent PNG.
Input image 1 is a MATERIAL AND STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: polished silver metallic hexagonal badge with sharp bevels. Do not include the reference badge in the output.
Create ONLY ONE small horizontal bottom plate / rank plaque designed to overlap the lower tip of that badge. A restrained, symmetric angular plaque, roughly 3.4 times as wide as tall: clipped upper corners, nearly horizontal top, shallow downward-pointing lower edge. Thick polished SILVER beveled rim, dark charcoal recessed center, clean planar metallic reflections matching the reference. Compact and understated, readable at small UI size; no decorative filigree, bolts, banners, ribbons or wings. Leave a generous blank central area for a separately rendered rank marker. No numbers, letters, stars, icon, emblem, text or watermark.
Front-facing orthographic view, exact bilateral symmetry, centered on a genuinely transparent background with a little padding. Crisp manufactured geometry, white highlights, mid-gray metal, deep charcoal grooves. Entire plate fully visible. This is an independent accessory asset, NOT a complete badge. Only the single blank plate. Landscape composition.
wings:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: separate modular wing-pair accessory for an achievement badge, transparent PNG.
Input image 1 is MATERIAL/GEOMETRY REFERENCE ONLY: a silver hexagonal badge. Input image 2 is the matching rank plate accessory, STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Include neither the hexagon nor the plate in this output.
Generate ONLY a single bilaterally symmetric pair of short angular metallic wings. A compact first wing upgrade for a game rank badge: each wing has three broad tapered stepped metal blades, with faceted silver bevels and dark recessed seams matching the reference. The outermost upper blade is longest, the lower two progressively shorter. The wings sweep gently upward and outward from small inner attachment roots. Engineered, geometric, restrained, readable as wings, not aircraft or realistic feathers. NO bird, crest, crown, laurels, shield, hexagon, plaque, text, stars or numerals.
Composition: very wide landscape canvas; pair centered and mirrored. The left wing occupies roughly left 35% of width; right wing occupies right 35%; leave middle 30% completely empty transparent, no connecting bar and no central badge, so a separate badge can be layered in front of the roots. Full tips visible with small transparent margins, no cropping. Inner roots are at the lower-inner ends; outside tips are a little higher. Both wings face front, orthographic, no perspective tilt.
Materials: neutral grayscale SILVER and charcoal only, white specular edges, smooth brushed-gray planar highlights, precise machined geometry. No gold or colored accents. No external drop shadow, background texture, fake checkerboard, glow or environment. Actual alpha transparency surrounding both wings AND throughout the gap between them. Exactly one coherent wing pair, not a sheet of options.
